_comment: Per-player overrides. EXPOSURE ("<sport>"): max fraction of the lineup set (0-1), either direction (0.80 = go overweight, 0.10 = fade, 0 = EXCLUDE the player entirely); object form {"min": 0.40, "max": 0.80} adds a minimum (filled first). OWNERSHIP ("<sport>_own"): projected field ownership 0-1, number or {"own": 0.55, "until": "YYYY-MM-DD"} (expires after that ET date); the rest of that position is rescaled to keep its total. NFL lineup lists: "nfl_stack_only" = players legal only with their own QB; "nfl_naked_ok" = QBs allowed to go naked. Name matching is order-insensitive. Edit weekly for injuries/news.
